motivation: The V1 unbounded connected closure percolates through sparse false-positive bridges despite high edge F1.

readouts.maximum_product: best product-of-edge-probabilities path from seed, bounded to the K highest settled regions
readouts.widest_path: best minimum-edge-probability path from seed, bounded to the K highest settled regions
readouts.dual_path_widest: remove every bridge from the thresholded undirected graph, then run bounded widest-path only inside the seed's remaining bridge-free component
readouts.multipoint_consistency: first direct neighbor then additions supported by at least two already-selected regions; rank by geometric mean of the two strongest direct supports

global_constants.per_readout_and_K_threshold_selection: maximize scene0001 instance-macro topology score then IoU then F1 then lower contamination then lower threshold

heldout_evaluation.aggregation: seed evidence weighted within instance then equal instance macro

promotion_to_v2_preregistration: recommend only if at least one frozen scene1-selected bounded rule clearly improves scene2 instance-macro IoU and F1 over singleton without material contamination
